tasks.GenerateProducts: Calculate all possible products between elements of both sorted lists.
tasks.HandleEmptyInput: Check if any input list is empty and return an empty result if true.
tasks.HandleExceedingN: If specified number of largest products exceeds total unique products, return all available unique products.
tasks.SelectTopN: Select the top N largest products from the generated list of products.
tasks.SortLists: Sort the input lists in descending order for efficient product calculation.
